service.method: SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , USER_ID , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , DEL_FLAG , DES_FILE_NAME , SRC_FILE_NAME , SIGN_TYPE , SIGN_SEQ , ATTACH_NO , ROOT_PATH_TYPE FROM SUDSM WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND USER_ID = ${session.ID} AND DEL_FLAG = 'N' AND ATTACH_NO = $S{ATTACH_NO}

SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , USER_ID , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , DEL_FLAG , DES_FILE_NAME , SRC_FILE_NAME , SIGN_TYPE , SIGN_SEQ , ATTACH_NO , ROOT_PATH_TYPE FROM SUDSM WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND USER_ID = ${session.ID} AND SIGN_SEQ = ${SIGN_SEQ} AND DEL_FLAG = 'N'

SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , USER_ID , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , DEL_FLAG , DES_FILE_NAME , SRC_FILE_NAME , SIGN_TYPE , SIGN_SEQ , ATTACH_NO , ROOT_PATH_TYPE FROM SUDSM WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND USER_ID = ${session.ID} AND SIGN_TYPE = $S{SIGN_TYPE} AND DEL_FLAG = 'N' AND SIGN_SEQ = ${SIGN_SEQ}

SELECT HOUSE_CODE ,DOC_NO ,DOC_SEQ ,ADD_DATE ,ADD_TIME ,ADD_USER_ID ,CHANGE_DATE ,CHANGE_TIME ,CHANGE_USER_ID ,TYPE ,DES_FILE_NAME ,SRC_FILE_NAME ,FILE_SIZE ,DEL_FLAG ,MOBILE_DOC_NO ,ROOT_PATH FROM SFILE WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND DOC_NO = ${ATTACH_NO} ORDER BY CONVERT(numeric, DOC_SEQ) ASC
